messages:
dylan-fin: Flagging a regional proxy mapping bug: APAC aggregator dropped customer_region tag, which caused embed events to be assigned NULL sku and fallback to internal test SKU. 

rachel-eng: ack. any customer impact numbers?

dylan-fin: quick scan shows ~2.4M embeds from 2024-07-02 00:00 to 2024-07-02 06:00 with sku = 'redwood-test' or sku = NULL, mostly APAC. Rough split: NovaApps ~900k, EdgeFin ~700k, misc customers ~800k.

tom-infra: repro: proxy log line: `INFO proxy: forwarded request with headers {\"x-region\": null}`. pipeline then ran sku_normalizer which maps null->redwood-test. I've pushed a hotfix to ensure region header is preserved.

dylan-fin: financial impact estimate at current embedding rate ~ $5,760 under-billed. Need provisional credit approval to avoid customer disputes while we replay and reconcile.

billing-bot: Auto-alert: discrepancy detected for acct_452 (NovaApps) and acct_781 (EdgeFin). Tickets INC-2309 (NovaApps), INC-2310 (EdgeFin) created.

rae-sales: NovaApps already called support; they noticed missing line items. If we credit immediately we should include a short note explaining it's provisional while we finish reconciliation.

omar-finance: Approve provisional credits totaling $5,760, limited to the two largest affected accounts for now (NovaApps, EdgeFin). Please attach note: "Provisional credit issued pending metering replay and verification." Billing ops to run adjustments.

rachel-eng: Mitigation plan: 1) ensure proxy header fix deployed to all APAC proxies (deployed to canary, rolling now) 2) run remap job to reassign events where sku IN ('redwood-test', NULL) AND created_at BETWEEN '2024-07-02T00:00:00Z' AND '2024-07-02T06:00:00Z' using mapping by request_id->account_id 3) recompute metering and generate per-account diffs.

tom-infra: Starting remap job now (background). ETA ~3h. I'll post job id and diff when complete.

dylan-fin: please also export a csv with rows: account_id, original_sku, new_sku, embed_count so billing ops can ingest.

billing-bot: Scheduled job: remap_embed_events job_789 queued by tom-infra. Progress updates will be posted here.

rae-sales: I'll draft a calm customer note: "We've identified a mapping issue that affected your embedding usage display. We've issued a provisional credit while we validate a permanent correction. We'll follow up after replay with final reconciliation."

omar-finance: Once remap diff is validated, finance will either reverse provisional credits or issue invoices for the delta. Keep all audit logs attached to the ticket.

rachel-eng: remap job started: job_789. Will update on completion.

tom-infra: job_789 completed. Replay diff: NovaApps +905,412 embeds, EdgeFin +702,819 embeds, Others +789,769. Pushing diff file to billing S3: s3://redwood-billing/replays/1759998888-replay-diff.csv

dylan-fin: received. billing ops: please consume the csv and push provisional adjustments. finance will reconcile in next billing run.

billing-bot: Billing ops notified. Tickets INC-2309 and INC-2310 updated with replay diff link.
